༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig gi lag 'grig bzhugs pa lags so ang*/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig gi lag 'grig bzhugs pa lags so ang*/

bla ma yi dam ḍākki la na mo/ /mkha' 'gro snying tig gi lag 'grig la/ dang po dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsgom/ las rgyu 'bras/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs/ thar pa'i phan yon bsam/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa bsgoms pa dang*/ sngon 'gro'i chos bzhi tshang bar bya/ de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ yig brgya bsgom bzlas/ maṇḍal 'bul ba/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams rim par bya'o/ /bskyed rim gyi skor la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi mthun byas/ rigs lnga mchod 'bum gyi bka' bsgo nas mchod pa byin brlab yan byas/ rigs lnga phyi sgrub ltar gzhal yas khang bskyed nas bdag bskyed rigs lnga nang sgrub la bya/ mdun bskyed rigs lnga phyi sgrub la byed/ spyan 'dren nas nang mchod 'bul ba yan dkyus bzhin bya/ de nas sman rag gtor gsum 'bul/ gsang mchod bya/ bstod pa dang bshags pa bya/ tshogs mchod bya/ lhag ma mkha' 'gro'i las byang nas btang*/ gtor lhag chad mdo bstan skyong dang bcas pa bya'o/ /mkha' 'gro'i las byang yang*/ skyabs 'gro nas mchod pa byin brlab yan dkyus bzhin no/ /gzhal yas khang rigs lnga phyi sgrub ltar ro/ /rta mgrin lus dkyil la bdag bskyed bya/ ḍākki mngon rtogs la mdun bskyed bya/ spyan 'dren nas nang mchod yan dkyus bzhin no/ /sman raka gtor gsum gsang mchod bya/ bstod pa gzhung ltar bya'o/ /tshogs mchod rgyas par byed pa la/ gong ma ltar spyan 'dren cig tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol ces pa sbyar ro/ /tshogs 'bul/ bskang ba bya/ las byang ltar bshags pa bya/ bsgral btab bya/ lhag chog bya/ shin tu gal che mkha' 'gro'i bskul yang bya/ gtor lhag bskyang ngo*/ /da dbang gi skor la slob dpon dang slob ma'i mtshan nyid brtags pa ni dang po'i dus su bya'o/ /sa chog bya/ dkyil 'khor stegs bu legs par byas te dris byugs/ me tog tshom phun gzhung ltar bkod/ bum pa bca'/ mngon rtogs rigs lnga phyi nang gis bsgom zhing tshogs yan tshang bar bya/

gsol ba gdab/ sta gon gyi cho ga rnams bya/ bum pa bsgrub/ slob bu sta gon bya/ dam tshig phog /thun mong gi rdzas bzhi gtad/ chos bshad/ de nas theg chog dang tshon chog bya/ de nas dal sgrub/ dal bstan pa'i skabs su dkyil 'khor gyi rnam dag bshad/ lha ngo bstan pa'i dus su lha'i rnam dag bshad/ de nas dbang bskur ba nas rjes chog yan dkyus ltar bya'o/ /rtsod pa'i skyon bsal/ de nas gsang dbang gi skabs su nub gcig la dbang rdzogs par byed na dbang rnams dkyus su bskur/ nub gsum ltar byed na gsang dbang gi dus su dkyil 'khor gong ma bzhag /gzhung ltar rdzas bsags la dbang bskur/ lha'i dkyil 'khor ngo yang sprad/ ces pa'i rjes su gsang dbang gi lhan thabs bshad sa bcad kyi lung bya/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bya ba'i skabs su gsol ba gdab/ dam tshig bsrung sdom bshad/ de nas mngon rtogs dran rdzogs bsgom/ gdong g.yogs ye shes dbab/ lhan thabs bshad/ nga'i bha ga gsang chen zhes pa nas/ de nas rdo rje tshig 'di brjod ces pa yan bya/ dbang gi rgyab yig bshad/ kye ma las ldan rigs kyi bu/ zhes sogs brjod/ de nas sa bcad bshad/ de nas tshig dbang bskur/ sa bcad bshad/ dbang bsgrigs su byed na rig pa yang rtsal gyi dbang byed/ dbang gi don khrid bya'o/ /de nas khrid kyi skabs su/ sngon 'gro dang bla ma'i rnal 'byor rnams gong du song nas/ dngos gzhi ni/ btags grol don khrid dang thod rgal don khrid nor bu'i snying po gnyis kyis khog phub/ thog rgal don khrid gsal sgron la gzhung bya/ khrid rgyab lung phreng gis spro ba bskyed/ rnal dbab yan chad tshang bar bya/ rab 'byams rig pa'i rtsal dbang rig pa sgron ma'i ti ka bshad/ khregs gcod ngo sprad/ rig pa yang rtsal gyi dbang bskur/ thod rgal gyi khrid bya'o/ /de rnams la brtags yig gis brtag /tshad yig gis tshad du skyol ma skyol brtag /lag khrid kyis zhag grangs gtan la phab po/

/bar do ngo sprod byed pa la/ dang po nyin mo'i ngo sprod la stegs bu dang yo byad thams cad bsags/ bsgom bzlas mchod bstod tshang bar bya/ gsol ba gdab/ gnang ba spyin/ bum dbang bskur/ shel la chos sku ngo sprad/ gsang dbang bskur/ me long dang rma bya'i mdangs kyi longs sku ngo sprad/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur/ me long g.ya' dag pa'i chos sku rang la gnas tshul nang du gzugs brnyan shar ba la ngo sprad/ tshig dbang rin po che bskur/ don rang rig gsal stong chos skur ngo sprad pa ni/ shel mig la ma reg tsam la bltas nas bla ma la bltas te rim gyis brtags nas de la ngo sprad/ de nas chos nyid bar do ngo sprod bya'o/ /de nas mtshan mo ngo sprod bya ba ni rdzas yo byad thams cad bsags te/ gtor ma'i dbang bskur/ rgyal thabs spyi blugs kyi dbang bskur/ de nas ngo sprod dngos la gsum ste/ sde skor sa la bkod pa ni bca' gzhi rnams so/ /brda skor mkha' la 'char ba ni/ 'ja' 'od la sogs pa'o/ /don skor rang la gnas pa ni rang gi sems nyid la'o/ /zhes ngo sprad do/ /des gzhan rnams tshig gis 'grel dang bstun nas bshad do/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i gsung las byung ba'i snying tig gi lag 'grig 'di/ bla ma'i gsung las byung ba bzhin du ma nor bar brjed tho yi ger btab pa ni/ bdag brjed ngas ches bas bris pa la bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gros bzod par gnang du gsol lo/ /maṅga laṃ/ shu bhaṃ/ bha wantu// // - mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (6)mkha' 'gro snying tig gi lag 'grig - PAGE 140 -- PAGE 139 -- PAGE 138 -
